name: Miyakoji (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Miyakoji village emblem in white: a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised mountain with a character.
history: Flag of the former village of Miyakoji in Fukushima Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-03-01.

features.role: Miyakoji village emblem — a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised mountain with a character
